class.name: NetwPredictRecovery
class.brief_description: How a misprediction is corrected, returned by [method NetwMultiplayer._predict_recover].
class.description: Create one with [method of] in an override of [method NetwMultiplayer._predict_recover]. The correction is applied at once. [codeblock] var staged := NetwPredictRecovery.of(restore, restore, false, false) [/codeblock]

method.name: of
method.description: Creates a correction. See each getter for the parameters.

method.name: restore
method.description: The values to set, keyed by property name.

method.name: teleport
method.description: [code]true[/code] to jump to the values instead of smoothing.

method.name: write
method.description: The values the display should show changing, keyed by property name. Usually the same as [method restore], or empty for no visible correction.
